static_traits.name: Lin Lan
static_traits.family_status: Good family support; specific structure not mentioned
static_traits.social_status: Has a few close friends; relationships with family and friends were once strained due to anxiety and stress
static_traits.medical_history: Underwent knee joint surgery within the past half year; no other important physical illnesses; no history of psychotherapy or similar psychological problems
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression and coherent thinking; able to identify and discuss their own negative thinking patterns; steady tone, high cooperation; often uses worst-case scenarios and all-or-nothing expressions, tends to focus on negative information

basic_info.main_problem: I feel overwhelmed by the stress of carrying heavy debt after graduation while temporarily unable to find work, with persistent stress and anxiety.
basic_info.core_demands: Seeks professional help due to overwhelming anxiety and stress related to financial situation and job seeking, hoping to obtain more effective coping and adjustment methods.
growth_experiences: About 6 months ago, the client underwent knee joint surgery: the surgical recovery period overlapped with the graduation transition period, increasing physical and mental pressure; afterward, anxiety and stress gradually appeared and worsened, affecting sleep, diet, and overall health.

After graduation, the client realized they lacked a stable job and had substantial student debt: when it was confirmed there was no stable source of income, the financial burden rose markedly; job-seeking setbacks led to doubts about their own ability and feelings of not being good enough, and anxiety and stress gradually increased.

special_situations.event: Receiving a rejection email for a desired position
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If one job application fails, it means I am not good enough and will not succeed in the future either.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Continuously submits large numbers of resumes, actively networks, and contacts career counselors for guidance.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not good enough; I may never find a job.

special_situations.event: Thinks about own financial situation and job prospects (especially when without stable income)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Without a stable job, I cannot repay my debts and my life will completely spiral out of control.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Steps up the job search and seeks advice and career guidance, hoping to quickly restore stability.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot repay the loan; everything is out of control.

special_situations.event: Currently in a state of unemployment after graduation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If there is no job now, it equals failure, not worthy of recognition.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Puts all energy into job seeking, while ignoring existing educational and skill advantages.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am just a failure, worthless.

special_situations.event: When evaluating their own situation, focuses only on the negative (debt, not being hired), ignoring available resources (a bachelor's degree, support from family and friends)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only fully resolving the debt and finding a stable job counts as worthy of affirmation; all other positive aspects do not count.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Downplaying or ignoring positive information and feedback, continuing to focus on problems and risks.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: My situation is utterly worthless; there is nothing worth affirming.

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized and accepted (being hired), and to gain stability and a sense of self-worth
core_conflict.fear: Fears rejection and being evaluated as 'not good enough', worrying about being unable to be independent and causing relationship strain
defense_goal: Proves own worth through continuous job seeking and improvement, reducing the fear of being negated
Preempting with self-criticism to reduce the sense of loss of control from external blows

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough rejected person / anxious job seeker
object_relations.object_representation: Others who support but do not fully understand oneself (family, friends, employers)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking in counseling about job rejections or future uncertainty
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Equates a single rejection with being unworthy of acceptance and inevitable future failure (transference: internalizing external evaluations as a negation of self-worth)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Low and self-deprecating tone, repeats expressions such as 'I am not good enough / I may never find a job', avoiding discussion of positive evidence and resources.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites them to view rejection from another angle or suggests recording thoughts
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worries that being too optimistic will make them lose vigilance and be underprepared for future blows.
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizes the worst possibility, uses hypothetical sentences like 'if... then it is over' to advance the conversation; tense tone, requests a backup plan be formulated.

manifestations: After graduation, facing the pressure of career choices and financial responsibilities
The sense of restriction from heavy debt and the loss of a sense of control
Uncertainty about the future direction triggers anxiety
Although supported by family and friends, feels they do not truly understand their sense of stress
Interpersonal relationships become strained under stress
outcomes: Emotional isolation and sense of alienation

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequently negating oneself in sessions with 'I am not good enough'
Views a single rejection as a wholesale negation of self-worth
Over-focusing on negative outcomes and ignoring existing resources (education, support)

positive_force: Having a bachelor's degree and a certain foundation of skills
Proactively taking action (submitting resumes, networking, contacting a career counselor)
Having support from family and a few close friends
Willing to try new methods (journaling, restructuring cognition)
negative_force: Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, all-or-nothing thinking, and mental filtering
Strongly binds self-worth to employment; prone to self-negation
Chronic anxiety affects sleep and eating, reducing overall functioning
Overly sensitive to rejection and overgeneralizes it into long-term failure

target_behavior.behavior: Persistent anxiety and catastrophizing worries (accompanied by affected sleep and eating)
antecedent: Thinking about one's financial situation and job prospects
Realizing temporarily having no stable work
target_behavior.core_reason: Overly binds employment with self-worth, and interprets debt and the future catastrophically, triggering the core belief 'I am not good enough'.
target_behavior.function: Obtains a subjective sense of control through excessive worry and anticipating the worst, attempting to lower the anxiety brought by uncertainty.
target_behavior.consequence: Sleep and eating are noticeably affected, interpersonal relationships are strained, occupational functioning declines, and overall well-being decreases.
